name: Italian-Style Chopped Salad with White Beans, Artichokes & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup white wine vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl along with mayo, vinegar, oil, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts and olives. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl.
Drain pickled onions. Add to the bowl, along with beans, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
